{{Top|leg}}
A '''telecom''' was a [[fiber-optic]] network used for communication. It was buried beneath the hardpan of [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], connecting homes and businesses. The service offered a directory of customers and an answering service.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
